about: Country cards for lives born in Bangladesh. Each card is dealt only to them (and a little more often than general cards). Sources are in each card's "src".

events.src: ===================== Bangladesh (BD) ===================== Microcredit: the Microcredit Regulatory Authority caps interest at 24% a year on a declining balance, since 2019 (The Business Standard; Financial Express). Business outcomes are game rules.

opts.do: cash += .3 * B; T('bd_micro', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.bd_micro'), v: .3 * B }); rec('bd_micro', .19 * B, 2); later(age + 1, 'sideBiz', { id: 'bd_shop', p: .55, a: .12 * B, n: 6 })
yearly('bdsave', { amt: .03 * B, until: age + 10 }, { rate: 0 }, 'trk.bdsave')

en..x: A microfinance NGO offers you a small loan to start a business, repaid in weekly instalments. Interest is capped at 24% a year by the Microcredit Regulatory Authority.
en..loan: Take the loan and open a small shop
en..loan.s: Get {a} now; repay about {b} a year for 2 years.
en..loan.h: About half of these small businesses bring in a steady extra income.
en..save.s: Save about {a} a year for 10 years.

zh..x: 一家小额信贷机构愿意借你一笔小钱做生意，每周分期还款。小额信贷监管局规定年利率最高24%。
zh..loan.s: 现在拿到{a}；每年还约{b}，还2年。
zh..loan.h: 这类小生意大约一半能带来稳定的额外收入。
zh..save: 改参加他们的储蓄计划

zht..x: 一家小額信貸機構願意借你一筆小錢做生意，每週分期還款。小額信貸監管局規定年利率最高24%。
zht..loan.s: 現在拿到{a}；每年還約{b}，還2年。
zht..loan.h: 這類小生意大約一半能帶來穩定的額外收入。
zht..save: 改參加他們的儲蓄計畫

events.src: The Gulf: remittances passed $30bn (FY2024–25, $30.33bn); a record 750,000+ workers went to Saudi Arabia in 2025 (Daily Star; Arab News). Migration costs, pay and housing multiples are ESTIMATES.

en..x: A recruiting agency offers a three-year job in Saudi Arabia at about {a} a year, with housing provided. A record 750,000 Bangladeshis went to work there in 2025, and remittances passed $30 billion in 2024–25. Migration costs are high and often borrowed.

zh..x: 一家中介给你一份去沙特的三年工作，年薪约{a}，包住宿。2025年有创纪录的75万孟加拉人去那里工作，2024–25年度侨汇超过300亿美元。出国费用很高，常常要借钱。

zht..x: 一家中介給你一份去沙烏地阿拉伯的三年工作，年薪約{a}，包住宿。2025年有創紀錄的75萬孟加拉人去那裡工作，2024–25年度僑匯超過300億美元。出國費用很高，常常要借錢。

events.src: Floods and cyclones: low-lying areas flood in most monsoon seasons and cyclones strike the coast (Bangladesh Meteorological Department). The chance that a flood or storm reaches you comes from EM-DAT (people affected a year, 2000–2024: js/data.js); premiums, damage and preparation costs are ESTIMATES.

en..x: Low-lying areas flood in most monsoon seasons, and cyclones strike the coast. Your home is close to a river.

zh..x: 低洼地区大多数季风季节都会淹水，沿海还会遭遇气旋。你家离河很近。

zht..x: 低窪地區大多數季風季節都會淹水，沿海還會遭遇氣旋。你家離河很近。

events.src: Sanchayapatra: the 5-year Bangladesh Savings Certificate pays up to 12.40% a year from Jan 2025, taxed 5–10% (UNB). With inflation near 9%, about 2% real: an ESTIMATE.

en..x: The five-year Bangladesh Sanchayapatra pays up to 12.4% a year (from January 2025), with 5–10% tax on the profit.
en..buy.s: Put {a} in. About 2% a year after inflation and tax.

zh..x: 五年期国民储蓄凭证（Sanchayapatra）年利率最高12.4%（2025年1月起），利息要缴5–10%的税。
zh..buy.s: 放入{a}。扣除通胀和税后每年约2%。

zht..x: 五年期國民儲蓄憑證（Sanchayapatra）年利率最高12.4%（2025年1月起），利息要繳5–10%的稅。
zht..buy.s: 放入{a}。扣除通膨和稅後每年約2%。

events.src: Universal Pension Scheme (from 17 Aug 2023): Surokkha for informal workers at Tk1,000–5,000 a month; Samata for low incomes at Tk1,000 with the government paying half (Daily Star; upension.gov.bd). Tk12,000 a year ≈ 0.11 of the game's typical wage. Real returns are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: yearly('upen', { amt: .11 * B, until: 60 }, { rate: .02, lock: 60 }, 'trk.upen')
yearly('upen', { amt: .055 * B, until: 60, bonus: 1 }, { rate: .02, lock: 60 }, 'trk.upen')

en..x: Since August 2023, informal workers can join the Universal Pension Scheme: Surokkha takes Tk1,000–5,000 a month, and Samata, for low incomes, takes Tk1,000 a month with the government paying half.
en..samata.s: About {a} a year; the government adds {b}.

zh..x: 从2023年8月起，非正规就业者可以参加全民养老金计划：Surokkha每月交1,000到5,000塔卡；给低收入者的Samata每月交1,000塔卡，政府出一半。

zht..x: 從2023年8月起，非正規就業者可以參加全民退休金計畫：Surokkha每月交1,000到5,000塔卡；給低收入者的Samata每月交1,000塔卡，政府出一半。

events.src: Moving to Dhaka: pay and cost multiples are ESTIMATES.

en..x: A job in Dhaka pays about {a} a year, but rent is higher and you’d be far from your family.
en..go.s: Pay {a} a year. Costs about 25% higher. Happiness −1.

zh..x: 达卡的一份工作年薪约{a}，但房租较高，而且离家人很远。

zht..x: 達卡的一份工作年薪約{a}，但房租較高，而且離家人很遠。

events.src: Private tutoring for the SSC and HSC exams is widespread (education household surveys); fees and outcomes are ESTIMATES.

opts.do: T('bd_tuition', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.tuition') }); rec('bd_tuition', .12 * B, 4); happy -= 1; kidWin(.3, .65)
T('bd_tuition', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.tuition') }); rec('bd_tuition', .04 * B, 4); kidWin(.2, .75)

en..x: Your child’s SSC exams are coming. Private tutors and coaching centres are everywhere, and many families pay for several subjects.
en..much.s: About {a} a year for 4 years. Busy evenings: Happiness −1.
en..much.h: A better chance of a scholarship later.
en..some: A tutor for the hardest subjects
en..some.h: Some chance of a scholarship later.
en..none.h: A small chance of a scholarship later.

zh..x: 孩子的中学毕业考试（SSC）快到了。私人家教和补习中心到处都是，很多家庭会请好几科。
zh..much.s: 每年约{a}，共4年。晚上很忙：幸福感 −1。
zh..much.h: 以后拿奖学金的机会较大。
zh..some.h: 以后有一些机会拿奖学金。
zh..none.h: 以后拿奖学金的机会较小。

zht..x: 孩子的中學畢業考試（SSC）快到了。私人家教和補習中心到處都是，很多家庭會請好幾科。
zht..much.s: 每年約{a}，共4年。晚上很忙：幸福感 −1。
zht..much.h: 以後拿獎學金的機會較大。
zht..some.h: 以後有一些機會拿獎學金。
zht..none.h: 以後拿獎學金的機會較小。

events.src: Samity: a neighbourhood savings group with a rotating pot. Risk ESTIMATE.

en..x: Neighbours run a savings samity: members pay in every month, and each month the pot goes to one member, drawn by lot.

zh..x: 邻居们办了一个储蓄互助会（samity）：会员每月交钱，每月抽签由一人拿走会钱。

zht..x: 鄰居們辦了一個儲蓄互助會（samity）：會員每月交錢，每月抽籤由一人拿走會錢。
